2nd September 2026


*Bramford to Twinstead*


We recently published the September edition of our e-newsletter, which we use to share updates from the construction of the Bramford to Twinstead Reinforcement.


In the latest update, you can learn more about:


- completed and upcoming works
- how we plan roadworks - and how you can help
- new ways to keep up-to-date via WhatsApp
- our Community Fund, which offers grants of up to £20,000.


**You can read the e-newsletter by clicking**[here](https://server.smartmailer.tractivity.io/View.aspx?q=2022%7cPoyoD%2bB6kGi%2brcrsMMwLr7H%2fF6yHcuzkPGcuzwHeGvJvsB8lsoHGKeMRKSOSQkWE2%2bAtefBDB2g%2fRb%2bSnUlhhI1dMoSLc6%2b1%2fDcfiup0k5TAkiedo7DMxpB63PE2QZG2) **. To receive the latest updates direct your inbox, you can sign up to receive our email updates by clicking**[here](https://nationalgrid.tractivity.io/ExternalFormViewer/Form.aspx?ExternalFormID=40) **.**
